text:
morgan: Heads-up: I'll open 3 docs PRs to move SDK examples and rename SDK guide paths. They touch redirects and anchors; need merge order and reviewers.
riley: Are previews available? We should avoid redirect loops in prod.
morgan: Netlify previews for each PR. I also added a tiny script to list changed heading ids: `scripts/headings-diff.sh main..feature/docs-move`.
carmen: Proposed order: 1) add temporary redirects (atomic yaml) 2) move example files and update includes 3) run anchor fixes and TOC updates 4) remove temp redirects. Keeps public 302s brief.
infra-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-410--docs.redwood.com (PR#410)
morgan: Assigning reviewers: @riley for content, @carmen for redirects. Will sequence merges and watch previews.
riley: Please include this checklist in each PR: preview link, link-check output, curl smoke, one content approval, CI green.
carmen: Also add TTL comment on redirects.yaml with removal ISO date. And record anchor-mapping.csv in the PR for consumers.
docs-bot: CI update: PR#411 lint OK, build failed on PR#412 due to TOC plugin mismatch.
morgan: Fixing TOC plugin config on PR#412 now. Plan to merge tomorrow 10:30-11:30 PST, one PR at a time, wait 10m between steps for CDN warm-up.
riley: I'll run linkinator after each merge and report any 404s here.
carmen: For curl verification: `curl -I https://docs.redwood.com/old/sdk/init` expect 302 to new path while redirects are active.
morgan: Thanks — I'll post PR links here once opened and will own sequencing.
riley: Great, standing by.
